claims.statement: EU and Polish rules provide late-payment interest and recovery-cost rights for qualifying commercial transactions, so an overdue invoice can be tied to a calculable claim event; applicability depends on the contract and facts.
The creditor is the proposed payer from recovered cash, eliminating an upfront budget request; acceptable contingency percentages and collectible volume remain unverified.

A written 12-month portfolio mandate can create durable workflow control while leaving claim ownership with the creditor; Polish legal review is required before debtor contact, fee setting, or escalation.
The official Polish late-payment rate is periodically announced, so calculations must be versioned by date rather than hard-coded.

commercial_mechanics.budget_owner: Owner, CFO, controller, or accounts-receivable lead
commercial_mechanics.bundling_resistance: Transparent statutory calculations, accountant-native onboarding, evidence quality, and measured recovery uplift must beat bundled dunning
commercial_mechanics.customer_relationship_owner: Founder company owns the creditor service relationship; creditor retains its debtor commercial relationship
commercial_mechanics.distribution_origin: Bookkeepers, accountants, trade-credit specialists, and targeted sector outreach

fully_loaded_economics.acquisition_cost: Accountant referral share and founder outbound; cash CAC recovered only on successful collections
fully_loaded_economics.cash_conversion: Contingency fee deducted or invoiced only after cleared recovery; long collection tails create delayed cash
fully_loaded_economics.contribution_margin: Unknown; target positive expected margin per claim after dispute and escalation probability
fully_loaded_economics.delivery_and_support_costs: Onboarding, evidence exceptions, debtor disputes, reconciliation, and creditor reporting
fully_loaded_economics.overhead_and_compliance: Debt-collection and legal-services review, GDPR/security, complaints process, insurance, and partner diligence
fully_loaded_economics.revenue_basis: Hypothesis: 10-20% of collected statutory interest and compensation plus 2-8% of principal where lawful and agreed
fully_loaded_economics.variable_costs: Messaging, payment processing, data checks, partner collection fees, and licensed legal escalation

commercial_mechanics.likely_incumbent_response: Accounting software, collection agencies, law firms, and invoice-finance providers can bundle reminders or recovery
commercial_mechanics.paid_event_or_measurable_loss: An unpaid invoice after the applicable due date is a measurable cash-flow loss and may create statutory interest and recovery-cost entitlements
commercial_mechanics.purchase_trigger: Growing overdue ledger, repeated manual reminders, cash squeeze, or unclaimed interest and recovery compensation
commercial_mechanics.renewal_event: Each successful collection and annual portfolio-mandate renewal

contrary_evidence: Creditors may intentionally avoid claiming interest to preserve important customer relationships.
Existing accounting tools, collection agencies, and law firms already serve the reminder and recovery workflow.

critical_control_point.acquisition_instrument: Twelve-month exclusive servicing contract for defined receivables, terminable for material breach and requiring consent for any assignment or legal escalation
critical_control_point.counterparty_refusal_fallback: Offer a nonexclusive self-service ledger or recruit other creditors; never contact debtors without documented authority
critical_control_point.current_owner: Each creditor retains ownership of its claims and grants only the contracted administration authority
critical_control_point.customer_relationship_owner: Founder company owns the creditor service relationship; creditor retains its debtor commercial relationship
critical_control_point.founder_access_description: The mandate is obtainable only through an ordinary written client contract; it does not assign claim ownership and relies on external licensed providers for activities reserved by law.
critical_control_point.launch_controller: Founder company after the creditor signs the mandate and supplies verified invoice and performance evidence
critical_control_point.renewal: Annual mutual renewal; individual claims close on settlement or documented withdrawal
critical_control_point.subject: Exclusive servicing mandate for a named creditor's defined overdue B2B invoice portfolio

economics.acquisition_route: Accountants, bookkeepers, trade-credit specialists, and targeted invoice-heavy sectors
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Illustrative, not forecast: administering 500m PLN annual overdue principal at a 1.5% blended realized fee implies 7.5m PLN revenue; a 5m PLN founder outcome requires high automation, lawful contracting, and low dispute labor
economics.founder_time: Three to five hours daily if disputes and legal work are routed to partners; no founder courtroom or call-center dependency
economics.gross_margin_basis: Automated triage and communications with paid external escalation only for positive-expected-value claims
economics.payback: Cohort payback only after collections clear; target under six months, unvalidated
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 10-20% of collected statutory amounts and 2-8% of principal where lawful and contracted
economics.retention_or_repeat: Continuous feed of new overdue invoices under annual servicing mandates

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Consented payment-delay, contact, evidence, and resolution patterns improve prioritization and intervention timing
fingerprint.customer: Polish SMEs with recurring undisputed B2B invoice delays and limited internal collection capacity
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Accountants, bookkeeping firms, trade-credit brokers, and direct outreach to invoice-heavy sectors
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Consent-based receivables ledger, evidence completeness, compliant reminder sequencing, statutory calculations, settlement tracking, and licensed escalation
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Creditor pays an agreed percentage when principal, late-payment interest, or recovery compensation is actually collected
fingerprint.problem_trigger: An invoice passes its contractual due date without payment after the supplier has performed

founder_fit: Receivables scoring, workflow timing, and cash forecasting align with finance and analytics interests
Recovered amount, cycle time, dispute rate, and expected value are measurable
Accountant channels reduce dependence on constant networking or public promotion
Automation and licensed escalation can keep the founder out of labor-intensive legal work
risks: Unauthorized or incorrect demands could create legal and reputational liability
Long recovery cycles strain cash conversion
Disputed performance evidence can require intensive human work
The service can become a low-margin collection agency rather than scalable software

structure.commercial_archetype: Contingency-fee claim administration under portfolio-specific exclusive mandates
structure.control_point: Durable contractual mandate to administer a defined client's overdue receivables workflow
structure.critical_dependency: Creditor authority, valid claim evidence, and licensed escalation where required

thesis: Acquire a 12-month exclusive servicing mandate over a client's identified overdue B2B invoices, automate evidence and statutory-interest calculations, and earn a contingency fee while licensed counsel or collection partners perform any reserved legal work.
title: Exclusive Late-Payment Recovery Mandate Ledger
uncertainties: Polish regulatory boundary for automated debt administration and contingency fees
Share of overdue invoices that are undisputed and collectible
Creditor willingness to grant a 12-month exclusive mandate
Debtor relationship damage and churn caused by standardized reminders
